note: Gage County zoning is published only as a PDF zoning map (county) and a static PNG zoning map (City of Beatrice). The county parcel viewer at gage.gworks.com is gWorks-hosted; its Gage_County_NE_Assessor MapServer has no zoning layer (Parcels layer carries only PID), and no Gage_County_NE_PZ service exists on mapserver01.gworks.com. Beatrice's ArcGIS web map (beatricebpw.maps.arcgis.com, item 312cd684...) only draws a 2-Mile Zoning Boundary polyline (services3.arcgis.com/I2jzMcLnq8BDWpwz, 2_Mile_Zoning_Map/FeatureServer/0, LIMIT_TYPE), not district polygons. No queryable zoning district polygon layer found for the county or its cities.
